title: 📜 General Rules
description:
• Treat all players and staff members with respect.
• Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, real-life threats, doxxing, and targeted personal attacks are prohibited.
• Offensive player names, group names, signs, or other visible content are not allowed.
• Do not impersonate staff members or falsely represent Project Blackout.
• Follow all reasonable staff instructions.
• False reports, fabricated evidence, and deliberately misleading staff are prohibited.
• Staff decisions must not be argued about publicly. Use a support ticket if you disagree.

title: ⚔️ PvP Rules
description:
• PvP and kill-on-sight are allowed everywhere outside designated Safezones.
• Combat logging is strictly prohibited.
• Disconnecting to avoid death, escape combat, protect loot, or gain an advantage is considered combat logging.
• If your game crashes during combat, reconnect as quickly as possible.
• Stream sniping and using another player’s broadcast to gain information are prohibited.
• Do not abuse relogging, restarts, animations, render issues, or glitches during combat.
• Logging into another account to gain a combat advantage is prohibited.

title: 💥 Raiding Rules
description:
• Raiding is allowed 24/7.
• Only intended raiding mechanics and approved raid tools may be used.
• Glitching, clipping, relogging, or abusing animations to enter a base is prohibited.
• Vehicles and deployable objects must not be used to bypass base defences.
• Logging out inside an enemy base to raid or attack later is considered ghosting.
• Raiders may take useful loot and destroy structures required to access it.
• Deliberately destroying, despawning, dumping, or hiding loot without a valid raiding purpose is considered griefing.
• Do not replace enemy locks, permanently block entrances, or claim a raided base.
• Every raid must follow the Raid Recording Requirements.

title: 🎥 Raid Recording Requirements
description:
• Every raid must be recorded by at least one member of the attacking group.
• The recording must cover the raid from before the first raid action until the group has finished and left the area.
• It must clearly show the location, entry method, destroyed raid points, and important actions inside the base.
• The original and continuous footage must be kept. Edited or incomplete footage may be rejected.
• Automatic recording splits are accepted if no part of the raid is missing.
• Raid footage must only be submitted when requested by staff.
• Failure to provide valid footage may cause the raid to be treated as illegal.
• Hiding, deleting, or editing footage to conceal a violation will result in additional punishment.

title: 🏗️ Base Building Rules
description:
• Maximum base size: **4 × 4 × 4** — width × length × height.
• Connected garages, towers, extensions, and storage areas count as part of the same base.
• A maximum of **10 locked access points** is allowed per base.
• This includes doors, gates, garage doors, roof hatches, and floor hatches.
• Bases must remain raidable through intended game mechanics.
• Unraidable, floating, overlapping, stacked, or exploit-based structures are prohibited.
• Multiple territories must not be used to bypass the size or door limit.
• Base structures must not clip into terrain or map objects in a way that prevents raiding.
• Illegal bases may be modified or removed without compensation.

title: 🚫 Restricted Building Areas
description:
Building is prohibited in or directly around:

• Military zones
• Safezones and trader areas
• Keyrooms and their entrances
• Event locations and event objectives
• Permanent toxic zones
• Important custom locations
• Main roads and bridges
• Water pumps and coastal spawn routes
• Underground entrances, tunnels, and important access points

Bases that block important locations or server content may be removed without compensation. Open a support ticket before building if you are unsure about a location.

title: 👥 Group Rules
description:
• The maximum group size is **four players**, including online and offline members.
• Rotating additional players into the group to bypass the limit is prohibited.
• Alliances and temporary teaming between separate groups are prohibited.
• Separate groups may not share bases, storage, vehicles, Code Locks, raid supplies, or group markers.
• Groups may trade, but trading must not become regular coordinated cooperation.
• Multiple groups may independently attack the same location, but they must not communicate, coordinate, or deliberately avoid fighting each other.
• Players who knowingly assist an oversized group may also be punished.

title: 🛡️ Safezone & Trader Rules
description:
• Do not attack, damage, trap, restrain, or push players inside Safezones.
• Stealing items or vehicles inside Safezones is prohibited.
• Do not enter, move, unlock, or interfere with another player’s vehicle.
• Do not block traders, garages, ATMs, parking areas, roads, entrances, or exits.
• Shooting into a Safezone from outside is prohibited.
• Do not repeatedly cross the Safezone boundary to abuse its protection.
• Scouting players from inside a Safezone for teammates waiting outside is prohibited.
• Trolling, mic spam, vehicle ramming, and deliberate obstruction are prohibited.
• The **Black Market is a full-PvP area** and is not protected by Safezone rules.

title: 🚗 Vehicle & Helicopter Rules
description:
• Vehicles and helicopters must not be used to enter bases through glitches or bypass raid defences.
• Do not intentionally block roads, traders, events, keyrooms, or base entrances with vehicles.
• Vehicle ramming and trolling inside Safezones are prohibited.
• Do not abuse desynchronisation, physics bugs, seat switching, or relogging for an unfair advantage.
• Aircraft must not be used to access restricted or unintended locations.
• Glitched, inaccessible, abandoned, or obstructive vehicles may be moved or deleted by staff.
• Compensation is not guaranteed for reckless driving, poor parking, or normal DayZ vehicle issues.

title: 🗝️ Keyrooms & Events
description:
• KOTH, airdrops, hacked crates, keyrooms, and other events are PvP areas unless stated otherwise.
• Fighting, ambushing, and contesting event objectives are allowed.
• Separate groups may contest the same event but may not cooperate.
• Do not block objectives, containers, doors, or access points with vehicles or deployable objects.
• Keyrooms may only be entered through their intended access method.
• Glitching through keyroom doors, walls, roofs, or floors is prohibited.
• Logging out inside a keyroom or restricted event structure is prohibited.
• Do not remain inside a keyroom to bypass its closing system.
• Bugs involving doors, keycards, crates, timers, or rewards must be reported and not abused.

title: 🚨 Cheating & Exploits
description:
• Cheats, hacks, scripts, unauthorised macros, and third-party tools are prohibited.
• Modifying game files to gain an unfair advantage is prohibited.
• Duplicating items, currency, vehicles, or equipment is prohibited.
• Knowingly using, storing, trading, or distributing duplicated items is also prohibited.
• Bug abuse and exploiting unintended mechanics are prohibited.
• Serious exploits must be reported privately and must not be shared publicly.
• If an exploit is triggered accidentally, stop using it and report it immediately.
• Claiming that an exploit was only being tested is not a defence without prior staff permission.

title: 👤 Alternate Accounts
description:
• Alternate accounts must not be used to bypass bans, group limits, raid rules, or other restrictions.
• Alternate accounts must not provide additional storage, hidden raid positions, enemy-base access, or combat advantages.
• Do not use another account to scout locations, watch a base, protect loot, or participate in the same fight.
• Helping another player evade a ban is prohibited.
• Sharing an account with a banned player may result in punishment.

title: 🎫 Reports & Support
description:
• Use the designated Discord ticket channels for reports, compensation requests, and appeals.
• Include all available evidence, such as videos, screenshots, timestamps, names, and locations.
• Evidence must show enough context for staff to understand the incident.
• Do not edit or crop evidence in a misleading way.
• Do not post reports publicly or encourage harassment against another player.
• Do not repeatedly contact staff through private messages.
• Compensation is only granted when the loss and its cause can be reasonably verified.
• Abusing the ticket system or knowingly submitting false reports may result in punishment.

title: 🔨 Punishments
description:
Depending on the violation, punishment may include:

• Warning
• Removal from an event or location
• Removal of items, currency, or vehicles
• Base modification or removal
• Character or inventory wipe
• Temporary ban
• Permanent ban

Severe violations such as cheating, deliberate duplication, ban evasion, doxxing, or real-life threats may result in an immediate permanent ban.

Groups may be punished together when members knowingly participate in, assist with, benefit from, or conceal a violation.

title: 📌 Final Information
description:
• By playing on Project Blackout PvP, you agree to follow all server rules.
• Ignorance of the rules is not an excuse.
• Finding a loophole in the wording does not make an exploit or unfair action acceptable.
• If you are unsure whether something is allowed, open a support ticket before doing it.
• Rules may be updated when necessary. Important changes will be announced on Discord.
• Players are responsible for keeping themselves informed about the current rules.

**Play fair, respect the community, and enjoy Project Blackout PvP!**
